hooks.title: Format on edit
hooks.summary: Runs `ruff format` on every Python file Claude edits.

hooks.title: Lint on edit
hooks.summary: Runs `ruff check` on every Python file Claude edits and reports violations to Claude.

hooks.title: Block dangerous commands
hooks.summary: Refuses `rm -rf /`, `git push --force` and `git reset --hard` before they run.
